# Undertale Yellow AP v0.3.0 Patch Notes

## Hotfix 1
- Spares and Kills will no longer overflow sending checks for other areas
- Only re-updating the Game Files is necessary for this hotfix

## Hotfix 2
- Fixed Manifest
- Please re-download the apworld to use on 0.6.8+
## New Features
- Sparesanity and Killsanity are here! Enable these options for checks behind Killing and Sparing enemies (20 Per area, 10 per area with Reduced Grind on)
- Skippers have been added to Dunes and Steamworks. Steamworks Skipper will allow you to skip to right before Guardener on any save in the multiworld after defeating Axis (only in all routes) and Dunes Skipper will remove the blockage outside the mines for any save in the multiworld after defeating El Bailador
- Added a few checks that were forgotten in previous versions
## Changes
- Added new save points in front of a small selection of areas
- Vending Machine has been nerfed in Pacifist/Neutral, now dispensing Monster Candy
- Pickaxe is now required to start the Ketsukane Sequence and goal pacifist (It was always logically required, but now the mod forces you to have it)
- Extra Stats has been split into three new options, Extra ATK, Extra HP, and Extra LOVE. These options are customizable to allow any amount of extra stats from 0-10
- New splash screen by P4ncakez
## Bug Fixes
-Fixed an issue where Ceroba would cease to exist in the first few rooms of the Steamworks
-Fixed an issue where the Client would fail to load under certain circumstances
-Fixed more issues that i forgot to write down and have forgotten... whoops
## Other Stuff
-Cleaned up the client code slightly
-Added Manifest
